# Travel Planner Skill for Muse

A comprehensive travel-planning assistant that learns you over time: on first use it collects your travel preferences (budget level, pace, accommodation, interests, dietary restrictions, languages, past trips) into a persistent local database, then builds each trip as a full package — destination research (visas, safety, seasons), day-by-day itineraries with realistic timing and buffers, budget breakdowns with category splits, packing checklists tuned to climate and activities, cultural do's and don'ts, and a pre-trip preparation timeline — plus expense tracking and budget status during the trip. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: preferences live in a local Python database the skill's scripts manage, so it's meant for a machine where you can run them; as with any planner, verify live prices, hours, and visa facts before booking. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
